Theorem
[Distance from the Lorentzian cosine] \group trigonometrySource: thurston:page-00281. 2.6.2For $X,Y\in H^n$, $c(X,Y)=\cosh d(X,Y)$.
Proof

\sketch Apply the geodesic equation to the unit-speed geodesic from $X$ to $Y$; its inner product with $X$ is $\cosh t$, and evaluation at $t=d(X,Y)$ proves the formula.

□
